description.zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and retrieve the remaining entries.

description.zh:
共享资源ARN列表。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享资源。
description.en:
A list of Alibaba Cloud Resource Names (ARNs) of the shared resources.

The value of N ranges from 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 shared resources.

description.zh:
共享资源ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享资源。
description.en:
The ID of the shared resource.

The value of N ranges from 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 shared resource IDs.

description.zh:
共享单元归属者。取值：

- Self：查询您创建的共享单元中，共享给其他账号的资源列表。
- OtherAccounts：查询其他账号创建的共享单元中，共享给您的资源列表。
description.en:
The owner of the resource share. Valid values:

- Self: Queries the resources that you shared with other accounts from your resource shares.

- OtherAccounts: Queries the resources that were shared with you by other accounts.

description.zh:
共享单元ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享单元。
description.en:
The ID of the resource share.

The value of N ranges from 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 resource share IDs.

description.zh:
共享资源类型。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务](~~450526~~)。
description.en:
The type of the shared resource.

For more information about the resource types that can be shared, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing](~~450526~~).

description.zh:
资源使用者ID或资源所有者ID。取值：

- 当`ResourceOwner`为`Self`时，该参数为资源使用者ID。
- 当`ResourceOwner`是`OtherAccounts`时，该参数为资源所有者ID。
description.en:
The ID of the principal or resource owner.

- If you set `ResourceOwner` to `Self`, this parameter is the ID of a principal.

- If you set `ResourceOwner` to `OtherAccounts`, this parameter is the ID of a resource owner.

title.zh: 查询共享或其他账号共享的资源列表

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询您在`cn-hangzhou`地域共享的资源列表。返回结果显示，您只共享过1个资源，即在共享单元`rs-6GRmdD3X****`内共享过`VSwitch`类型的资源`vsw-bp1upw03qyz8n7us9****`。
descriptions.en: This example shows how to query the resources that you shared in the `cn-hangzhou` region. The response indicates that you shared only one resource, which is a `VSwitch` with the ID `vsw-bp1upw03qyz8n7us9****` in the resource share `rs-6GRmdD3X****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcesharing list-shared-resources --resource-owner Self --resource-type VSwitch --target 1720505253000000 --max-results 20 --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --resource-share-ids rs-6GRmdD3X0000 --resource-ids vsw-bp1upw03qyz8n7us90000 --resource-arns acs:vpc:cn-shanghai:1037554691870000:vswitch/vsw-uf62b11ue4m8oz2di0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcesharing ListSharedResources --region cn-hangzhou --Target 1720505253000000 --NextToken TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --ResourceShareIds.1 'rs-6GRmdD3X0000' --ResourceOwner Self --MaxResults 20 --ResourceIds.1 'vsw-bp1upw03qyz8n7us90000' --ResourceType VSwitch --ResourceArns.1 'acs:vpc:cn-shanghai:1037554691870000:vswitch/vsw-uf62b11ue4m8oz2di0000'
